source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Thishoban if its same rule as salesuk.js: first-session utm_campaign contains "THISOBAN" OR utm_term exactly "THISOBAN".. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban -> Theekshy -> Thanishtika) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
